```{r, message=FALSE}

library(PCBS)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
```


```{r}
# get the dictlist and gtf for out testing data
data(testing)
```

# Make a peak track at a gene:

Here we show a minimal example:
```{r}

makeGeneTrack(DictList = testing_dicts, gtf = GTF, gene="Adgrb3")

```
